author: Inside Edition
description: Scarlett Jernigan's first aid skills and quick thinking helped a man after he was shot in the head. It happened when the 19-year-old went to Holy Vape & Smoke in Texas. She walked in and saw an injured man hunched over, and immediately took off her shirt to use as a compress to stop the bleeding. Once the victim was stable, she learned more about the armed robbery that took place just seconds before she arrived. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Texas Teen Uses First Aid Training To Help Man After Armed Robbery
